Not sure what the solution can be yet, but this is likely a problem related to https://martijnhols.nl/blog/everything-about-google-translate-crashing-react, although I'm not fully sure which DOM change happens that can't be followed. Which code do you have exactly for the show more button? As you're using the connector the actual JSX matters.

I think your solution likely is to ensure the whole translated string is wrapped in a span as described in the article
